nodes.description: Owner address stored in Ownable; set in constructor from _msgSender and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Reflection ledger mapping address to reflected balances; mutated in _transferStandard and _takeTeam.
Records first buy timestamp per address; drives 24h sell tax logic.
ERC20 allowance mapping written by _approve and consumed in transferFrom.
Fee exclusion whitelist consulted inside _transfer.
Blacklist mapping enforced by require(!bots[from] && !bots[to]) in _transfer.
Per-address cooldown timestamps, gated by block.timestamp when cooldownEnabled.
Total reflected supply reduced by _reflectFee and used in _getRate/_getCurrentSupply.
Accumulated token fees incremented in _reflectFee.
Tax fee numerator set dynamically in _transfer and read by _getTValues.
Team fee numerator set dynamically in _transfer (14 to 25 percent) and read by _getTValues.
Payable fee wallet receiving half of swapped ETH; also the authorization key for manualswap/manualsend.
Payable fee wallet receiving the other half of swapped ETH in sendETHToFee.
Uniswap V2 router instance set in openTrading and used for swaps and liquidity.
Liquidity pair address created in openTrading; determines buy/sell direction in _isBuy.
Trading state flag toggled in openTrading.
Reentrancy guard flag set by lockTheSwap modifier and checked in _transfer.
Enables automatic contract-token swapping in _transfer.
Enables the per-address transfer cooldown branch in _transfer.
Maximum transfer amount enforced with require(amount <= _maxTxAmount).
Constant total token supply of 1e12 * 10**9 used across rate calculations.
Private core transfer routine: computes dynamic taxes, applies bot/cooldown/maxTx checks and triggers swaps and ETH payouts.
Private lockTheSwap function that approves and swaps contract tokens for ETH through the router.
Private function that pushes contract ETH to the two fee wallets via transfer.
onlyOwner function that deploys the pair, adds liquidity and enables swapping/cooldown.
onlyOwner function that blacklists an array of addresses.
External function guarded only by _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 that swaps the whole contract balance.
External function guarded only by _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 that forwards contract ETH.
Private function that applies reflected balance changes, team fee and fee reflection for a transfer.
onlyOwner function that overwrites _maxTxAmount.
onlyOwner function that sets _maxTxAmount from a parameter.
onlyOwner function toggling the cooldown feature flag.
Public ERC20 transfer entry point delegating to _transfer with _msgSender().
Public ERC20 transferFrom entry point delegating to _transfer and reducing allowance.
Public ERC20 approve entry point delegating to _approve.
onlyOwner function that zeroes the owner address.
Deploys the token, assigns the whole reflected supply to the deployer and whitelists fee wallets.
Private view returning rSupply divided by tSupply.
Private view returning r/t transfer, fee and team amounts for a transfer.
Private function that decreases _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
Private function that credits reflected team fees to the contract address.
Private function writing the allowance mapping and emitting Approval.
Private view converting a reflected amount into a token amount using the current rate.
Public view returning tokenFromReflection of the caller-requested account balance.
Private wrapper routing all transfers into _transferStandard.
onlyOwner function removing an address from the bot blacklist.
onlyOwner function restoring _maxTxAmount to the full supply.
Private pure function splitting a token amount into transfer, fee and team portions from fee numerators.
Private pure function converting token amounts into reflected amounts using the current rate.
Private view returning reflected and token supply used by _getRate.
Private view returning whether the sender is the uniswap pair, deciding buy versus sell tax.
Caller-controlled address used as transfer initiator, owner check and manual function authorization.
Miner-influenced timestamp driving the 24h sell tax, first-buy recording and cooldown gating.
Native ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet1 and _feeAddrWallet2 executed inside sendETHToFee.
External router call swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens invoked mid-transfer.
External payable addLiquidityETH call in openTrading that consumes the whole contract ETH balance.
External factory createPair call that determines the uniswapV2Pair address.
from address parameter of _transfer.
to address parameter of _transfer.
amount parameter of _transfer checked against _maxTxAmount.
tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForEth.
amount parameter of sendETHToFee split by div(2).
tAmount parameter of _transferStandard and _getValues.
bots_ array parameter of setBots.
maxTransactionAmount parameter of setMaxTx.
Local swap path array built in swapTokensForEth.

edges.reason: msg.sender flows into _transfer as the from address via transfer and transferFrom, so any caller controls the transfer direction.
block.timestamp selects the 24h-high-tax sell branch and gates the cooldown require inside _transfer.
block.timestamp is written into cooldown[to] as block.timestamp + 30 seconds.
block.timestamp is recorded into _buyMap[to] on the first buy, fixing the 24h tax window.
from parameter feeds zero-address checks, tax classification and bot/cooldown logic in _transfer.
from parameter reaches _transferStandard as sender and debits _rOwned[sender].
to parameter feeds the zero-address check, buy detection and cooldown branch of _transfer.
amount parameter is compared against _maxTxAmount and later split by SafeMath in the fee helpers.
_feeAddr1 tax numerator is read by _getValues to compute the fee portion.
_feeAddr2 team numerator set in _transfer is read by _getValues.
Tuple of r/t amounts and fees returned by _getValues is consumed by _transferStandard for balance arithmetic.
_rOwned balances are read for sender and recipient before subtraction and addition.
_transferStandard writes updated reflected balances back into _rOwned.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal, changing the global reflection rate.
_reflectFee accumulates tFee into _tFeeTotal.
_takeTeam mints reflected team fee into the contract's _rOwned entry.
tAmount parameter is the base for all reflection and fee arithmetic in _transferStandard.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and passed to the router swap call.
amount parameter is halved with div(2) for each fee wallet payout in sendETHToFee.
_feeAddrWallet1 receives amount.div(2) in sendETHToFee.
_feeAddrWallet2 receives amount.div(2) in sendETHToFee.
manualswap authorization relies solely on _msgSender() equalling _feeAddrWallet1, a weak single-address check.
manualsend authorization relies solely on _msgSender() equalling _feeAddrWallet1.
_tTotal initializes _maxTxAmount as the default maximum transaction size.
_transfer delegates final balance mutation to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to burn reflected fees and record token fees.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to route the team fee to the contract.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth on the contract balance before transfer state is finalized.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee to push ETH out while the transfer is still in flight.
setBots is protected by the onlyOwner modifier comparing _owner to _msgSender.
openTrading is onlyOwner but centralizes pair creation, liquidity and limits under one key.
updateMaxTx is onlyOwner and can silently change the transfer limit.
setMaxTx is onlyOwner and rewrites _maxTxAmount.
setCooldownEnabled is onlyOwner and toggles cooldown enforcement.
renounceOwnership is onlyOwner and permanently drops ownership.
delBot is onlyOwner and can un-blacklist addresses.
removeStrictTxLimit is onlyOwner and removes the strict transaction cap.
openTrading adds liquidity with the entire contract ETH balance via addLiquidityETH.
openTrading creates the trading pair through the factory.
openTrading assigns the router instance to uniswapV2Router state.
openTrading stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap of contract tokens for ETH.
sendETHToFee performs native ETH transfers to the two fee wallets.
Public transfer entry point calls the private _transfer routine.
Public transferFrom entry point calls _transfer then reduces the allowance.
balanceOf converts reflected balance through tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection derives its conversion rate from _getRate.
_transfer routes the actual token movement through _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard for balance mutation.
_approve writes allowance amounts into the _allowances mapping.
_transfer calls _isBuy to decide whether the sender is the liquidity pair.
uniswapV2Pair is compared with the sender inside _isBuy to flag buys.
The router swap is an external call executed in the middle of _transfer with the inSwap guard failing to cover the whole transfer path, enabling reentrancy into token transfers.
Native ETH transfers to fee wallets occur before the transfer completes, giving the recipient a callback window into _transfer.
_transfer indirectly triggers _approve through swapTokensForEth before swapping tokens.
_getRate obtains reflected and token supply from _getCurrentSupply.
_getValues derives token fee values from _getTValues.
_getValues derives reflected values from _getRValues.
msg.sender is used as both the spender and the from address in transferFrom allowance checks.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline and used for the initial maxTx setup.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a plain parameter of _transfer that only carries the caller-supplied source address into the core transfer logic.
to is a plain parameter of _transfer that only carries the caller-supplied destination address into the core transfer logic.
amount is a plain parameter of _transfer used only for the maxTx comparison and downstream fee math.
tokenAmount is a plain parameter of swapTokensForEth used only as the approved and swapped amount.
amount is a plain parameter of sendETHToFee used only as the split payout base.
tAmount is a plain parameter of _transferStandard and _getValues that only seeds the reflection arithmetic.
bots_ is a plain array parameter of setBots consumed entirely by the blacklist loop.
maxTransactionAmount is a plain parameter of setMaxTx assigned directly to _maxTxAmount.
path is a local array built and consumed only inside swapTokensForEth for the router call.
